mapper.select: select cs.supplier_id, s.name as supplier_name, s.supplier_code, s.status from crm_customer_supplier cs inner join crm_supplier s on cs.supplier_id = s.id and s.deleted = 0 where cs.customer_id = #{customerId} order by s.status desc, s.id
select supplier_id from crm_customer_supplier where customer_id = #{customerId}

select cs.supplier_id, s.name as supplier_name, p.id, p.name, p.no, p.product_code, p.type, p.source, p.price_detail, p.base_sell_price, p.base_cost_price, p.status, p.description, sp.min_cost_discount, sp.max_cost_discount, sp.min_sell_discount, sp.max_sell_discount, sp.min_agent_discount, sp.max_agent_discount, sp.daily_usage_amount from crm_customer_supplier cs inner join crm_supplier s on s.id = cs.supplier_id and s.deleted = 0 inner join crm_supplier_project sp on sp.supplier_id = cs.supplier_id inner join crm_model_product p on sp.project_id = p.id where cs.customer_id = #{customerId} and p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 1 order by s.id, p.id
